about.legislature: Congress: Senate (103) and Chamber of Representatives (183)

offices.President: Elected with the vice president on a joint ticket for a single four-year term, by a two-round system: if no candidate wins a majority in the first round, the top two meet in a run-off. The president is head of state and of government.
offices.Senate: 103 senators are elected for four years: 100 by proportional representation in a single nationwide constituency, 2 in a constituency for Indigenous communities, and 1 seat goes to the runner-up in the presidential election. It makes laws together with the Chamber of Representatives.
offices.Chamber of Representatives: 183 members are elected for four years: 161 by proportional representation in the 32 departments and Bogotá, plus seats for Afro-Colombian, Indigenous, Raizal and overseas voters, 16 transitional peace seats for victims of the conflict and 1 for the vice-presidential runner-up. It makes laws together with the Senate.
